mission: Enforce the existing one-active-exact-print-per-source invariant in every supported approval writer

impacts.reason: Reject a different source listing while the exact physical print/source pair is already active. Source-row serialization also protects concurrent distinct proposal approvals. Preserve existing manual mappings and all history; contained duplicate results cannot replay as active approval.

routes: Existing exact proposal approvals and SNKRDUNK direct approval endpoint
dependencies: Unchanged exact physical CardPrint and manual identity guards; no schema change
impact.deployment_impact: Native staging API/frontend; no collector build, schedule, budget, HTTP concurrency or PSA10 activation.

recovery.procedure: Keep automatic approvals contained and restore retained API code if needed. Preserve original manual mappings, raw snapshots, observations and all review receipts.
recovery.trigger: A second current active exact print/source mapping or an inactive mapping reported as eligible approval replay
recovery.backup: Only bounded application guards. The three incident mappings are retained inactive; two valid same-print source observations remain retained with their original lineage.

verification.observation_window: Verify live source/print reconciliation and delivery before resuming guarded exact approvals. Skip individual already-monitored print/source proposals; all remaining ordinary due consumers continue normally.
